messages:
maya: FYI linkcheck is red. several broken fragments after the last copy edit pass. examples: '#client(initialization)', '#using-the-:zap:-shim', and '#integrations/aws(lambda)'. CI shows 9 failures.

kevin: hmm. those were written literally in a few older guides. Docusaurus slugify removes punctuation and emoji so anchors become 'client-initialization', 'using-the-zap-shim', 'integrations-aws-lambda'.

nora: short-term fix: update explicit markdown links to the slugified forms. i can open a tiny PR touching only the 9 files CI flagged. will include a before/after diff in the PR description.

maya: please also add a note in CONTRIBUTING.md about canonical fragment format (lowercase, hyphen, ascii). saves repeat fixes.

kevin: also found two Swift snippets rendering inline due to CRLF in fences. normalized those in my branch; will add a linter rule to catch CRLF inside code fences.

docs-bot: preview deploy for branch 'nora/anchor-normalize' is ready https://deploy-preview-430.docs.redwood-inference.com

nora: opening PR now. plan: (1) replace explicit fragment links in flagged files, (2) add tiny validate-fragments.sh that checks rendered HTML for anchors before full linkcheck, (3) update CONTRIBUTING.md. tagging @maya + @kevin for review.

maya: approved for review. please include ticket INFRA-2399 in the PR body and a note about redirects for external links we might break.

kevin: i'll follow up with a redirects.yaml proposal for the top 5 legacy anchors so external posts don't 404.

nora: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/892. thanks!
